key_insight: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth pairs four-class Alzheimer's MRI classification with more stable saliency maps highlighting disease-associated brain regions.
clinical_relevance: The approach may help researchers interpret MRI model predictions, but its suitability for clinical diagnosis remains unvalidated.
method: Train custom CNNs on 2D axial MRI images for four-class staging.
Use WGAN-GP synthetic samples to address Moderate Dementia class imbalance.
Combine eigenvector-based Grad-CAM, principal component analysis, and Gaussian-noise smoothing to generate heatmaps.
evidence_signal: On the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, the study reports 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, MCC of 0.944, and class-level ROC AUCs of 0.96–0.99.
watch_item: Further clinical validation is needed; highlighted brain regions alone do not establish that predictions are clinically reliable.
paper_title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
